contribution.summary: Qualify an immutable Numerics publisher rehearsal using unchanged original sources, exact published IR/Quantities closure, disposable-feed publication, collision/digest/cancellation refusals and fifteen compiled package-only checks.

debtChanges: RS168 succeeded at attempt 003 after two allocated and two preparation failures; F35 qualified the original unpublished Numerics candidate with fifteen binary checks and one exact IR dependency.
Rehearsal archive bytes are independently recorded and never substituted for the original immutable F35 candidate, even when source and package identity match.
RS169 never publishes to shared NUGET_LOCAL, changes source versions, grants public license, qualifies installed rollback or authorizes external/AURA/Decision/Discovery adoption.
